openQuestions: Partial breadth pass:31 cards/35 generation-family records inventoried; raw models-auto has only ONE Daewoo entry, Espero. This is an extraction/attribution coverage gap, not evidence30 other selected identities are invalid.
Three Korean-specific generations now ended: Lacetti Premiere, Matiz Creative M300, Winstorm. Scope is explicitly Daewoo badge in South Korea; precise final-assembly dates left null.
The source2011 rebranding announcement and subsequent Winstorm-to-Captiva retrospective establish ended nameplate usage, not a universal global Daewoo production cutoff.
Do not automatically add GM Korea Q497193 to relatedQids without brand/time constraints: the company also manufactures Chevrolet cars, and indiscriminate attribution would create wrong-brand models.
Gentra Uzbekistan2013 is separate from T250 Korea Gentra. Existing Kalos summary already distinguishes them; a new selected generation/model needs exact production evidence.
Damas/Labo Uzbekistan and Korea periods, Nexia/Matiz continuing export badges, and Daewoo versus Chevrolet/Ravon/FSO/ZAZ transitions need independent market-specific dates.
G2X, Veritas, Statesman and Winstorm MaXX statuses/dates remain unverified in this pass; no exact dates inferred from related Opel/Holden/Saturn cars.
Make foundedYear1972 versus later Daewoo brand naming and GM Daewoo incorporation2002 remain entity-scope questions; no unsupported founding/dissolution correction.
Existing photos, trims, historic generation intervals and full model-list extraction audit remain open.
summary: Partial Daewoo sweep corrected three ended Korean nameplate statuses with explicit badge-market scope, proposed missing Korean make country metadata, and identified severe raw-model undercoverage plus Uzbek Gentra coverage and brand-period distinctions.
